title: BoardCard
description: One record of GET /v1/board (docs/plan/01 §2.2 "Board and validated pull", D51; M1 slice plan P4b): a task's card, derived only from its task record and its graph nodes in the read's snapshot, with its node cards. Its column is never written: a card whose column the records do not determine fails the read. A card carries references only, never the task's acceptance (its attachments' names or digests) nor the spec digest computed over them. The title is untrusted text.

column.description: awaiting_approval: Ready, its spec's approval not in force; ready: approved and not admitted, or admitted with nothing running; running: a plan or build node claimed or held; verifying: an accept, gate or review node claimed or held; done_candidate: a review node completed go, merge inactive.

admitted.description: The admitted badge: the task holds admitted WIP, held or not.

approval.description: Its spec's approval: none, in force, or revoked.

nodes.description: The task's nodes in node id order, superseded ones included as history.

holds.description: The external waits, one badge per hold: what holds, the signal that resumes it, its owner and its age at the read.

waiting.description: The structural waits (waiting(input)), one badge per missing input, naming its producer node or the owed input it answers.
